audit.whatIsWrong: The lane is graded 'Hard matchup — difficulty 7/10' with a red tone while the diff token says FAV and Sett wins 53.93% of 1502 games. The level chart itself I did NOT touch — see notes and questionsForUser.
audit.why: diff, tone and the final rating line disagreed with each other and with the data. The chart is a separate problem: the packet's own defect list flags it ('Sett wins 53.93% but the chart gives Camille 5/7 stages vs 1'), the packet chart and the page chart differ from each other, and the mirror audit recorded no chart correction — so I have no authority to pick a shape without inventing power shifts.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, tone gold, diffRating 6/10, and the two rating strings brought into line. Chart rows left untouched and raised as a question.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hookshot was tracked all over the page with no cooldown attached, and 'Hextech Ultimatum' is a near-miss for the real name.
audit.why: Hookshot is 16/15/14/13/12s and requires a wall — off walls it does not exist. Riot's name is The Hextech Ultimatum, 140/115/90s at 475 range. Tactical Sweep is 15/14/13/12/11s.
audit.corrected: The 16s number written into the cooldown panel, the do's, the don'ts and report[5]; the wall requirement made the actual positioning rule; the ability renamed in spikes[1], whys[5] and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: One fabricated claim and three absent interactions. Fabricated: 'Your R The Show Stopper can answer by suppressing her'. Absent: Adaptive Defenses shields against the damage type that just hit her; Tactical Sweep's outer half heals her; Precision Protocol's recast hits far harder if she pauses between the two autos.
audit.why: Riot's text for The Show Stopper is carry, slam, damage and a landing slow — no suppression, and the mirror audit restated it the same way. Adaptive Defenses shielding physical against Sett is why a blind commit does nothing, and the deliberate pause between her Q autos is a visible tell the page never named.
audit.corrected: Suppression removed from spikes[1]; the type-matched shield stated in dosFull[2].d; Tactical Sweep's heal tied to the Executioner's Calling timing in report[8]; the Precision Protocol pause tell written into dontsFull[2].d.
sources: champ-data/_kits/camille.json (P shield, W heal, Q autoReset/trueDamage)

audit.whatIsWrong: Two derived flags on this pair contradict Riot's own descriptions and I deliberately wrote neither: 'untargetable' and 'channel' on The Hextech Ultimatum, and 'grounding' on The Show Stopper.
audit.why: Riot describes The Hextech Ultimatum as a dash that anchors the target — no channel, no untargetability. Riot describes The Show Stopper as a carry, slam, damage and landing slow — no grounding. Each of those would flip the 1v1 if true (Facebreaker cancelling her ult; grounding deleting Hookshot), so asserting them from a tooltip-parsed flag would be the worst kind of error.
